name: SEED-AS: SEED new-participant hold-out, all-sessions training
design_status: Frozen before any SEED-AS model outcome exists. Copy of the 2026-09-17 E1 protocol (plans/2026-09-17-jne-e1-seed-cross-subject.json); see differs_from_e1 and exposure.
differs_from_e1: differs from the 2026-09-17 E1 plan only in items (2) and (4): (2) training data: source participants contribute all three sessions instead of session 1 only; (4) input standardisation: per recording, label-free, instead of training-participant statistics. Everything else (folds, models, optimiser recipe, 80 epochs, seeds, candidate grid, calibration permutations/rotations, label schedule, scored pools, endpoints, analysis code) is identical; only the protocol id, paths and descriptive text names differ.
exposure: E1 (session-1 training, source-statistics standardisation) results on the same folds and participants were known when this plan was written; this experiment extends that protocol and does not confirm it on untouched participants.
predictions_written_before_running: P1: target accuracy at epoch 80 (window accuracy on the scored clips, participant mean) is higher than in the 2026-09-17 participant hold-out for both models (reference values 0.486 for DGCNN, 0.528 for MLP).
P2: for both models the retained gain of the zero-label policy, U80-U5, has a 95% participant-bootstrap interval that includes zero.
P3: for DGCNN the retained gain of the calibrated policy (one labelled clip per class), A80-A5, is positive with a 95% participant-bootstrap interval that excludes zero.
P4: for both models selection on the scored clips themselves exceeds the zero-label choice at K=80 (O80-U80 > 0) with a 95% participant-bootstrap interval that excludes zero.

Written 2026-11-12 by the project lead with the 2026-09-17 participant hold-out results known and before any cell of this experiment was fitted on SEED data. Whichever way they come out, all are reported and no cell, model or policy is dropped.
dataset: SEED official 1-second DE/LDS, 15 participants x 3 sessions x 15 trials. Training: the 9 source participants of a fold, sessions 1-3 (27 recordings, 91,638 windows). Validation and target participants: session 1 only (their session-2/3 recordings are not loaded), 15 trials each.
scored_pools: validation and target participants, SESSION 1 only; units keyed (participant, trial), 45 per pool, as in E1
fold_source: identical to E1 plan folds (strict five-fold partition, seed 2024)
training_source: identical to the E1 plan (v4 cross-session recipe); epoch count counts passes over the larger training set, so gradient steps per epoch triple
normalization: per recording, label-free: every loaded recording (participant x session) is standardised per feature (62x5) with the mean and std of its own windows (ddof=0, float64 statistics, std floor 1e-6); for validation/target participants that recording is their session-1 recording (all 15 trials, unlabelled, as in jne_e1_faced._subject_standardise). No statistics are shared across recordings; both models.
candidate_rule: nested grid 80/K, 2(80/K), ..., 80 (same as rotation_v2 and v4)

calibration.rule: rotation r: C = perms[c][r] for each class c; B = remaining target trials
calibration.secondary_rule: rotation r: C = perms[c][r], perms[c][(r+1)%5]; B = remaining (B differs from k=1; reported separately)

policies.U_K: select on pooled validation-participant windows; score on target B (zero target labels)
policies.A_K: select on target C windows; score on target B (calibration labels, no weight update)
policies.O_K: select on target B; score on B. Diagnostic only, computed after U/A are exported

primary_endpoints: zero-label retained change U_80 - U_5 on B
calibration retained change A_80 - A_5 on B
primary_inference: per model (DGCNN, MLP): the three endpoints on the frozen nested grid; exact sign-flip permutation p over 15 participants with Holm correction across the three endpoints within model; participant bootstrap 10000 (seed 20260917); analysis = experiments/jne_e1_analysis.py unmodified

retention_definitions.zero_label: apparent = a_V(h_V(80)) - a_V(h_V(5)); retained = a_B(h_V(80)) - a_B(h_V(5))
retention_definitions.calibration: apparent = a_C(h_C(80)) - a_C(h_C(5)); retained = a_B(h_C(80)) - a_B(h_C(5))
retention_definitions.summary: aggregate ratio mean(retained)/mean(apparent) and OLS slope over participants, as in experiments/jne_retention_curve.py

aggregation: average over 3 seeds and 5 calibration rotations within participant; n=15 participants; participant bootstrap 10000, seed 20260917
pilot: fold1/dgcnn/seed2024 first; gate only finite loss, shapes, label validity; included unchanged; low accuracy is not an exclusion or tuning trigger
stopping: all 30 cells retained; no significance-dependent expansion or tuning
boundary: SEED released features with upstream LDS smoothing; every participant watched the same 15 films in every session, so participant hold-out is not stimulus hold-out. Training uses sessions 1-3 of the source participants; targets and validation participants are scored on session 1 only and never contribute any window, label or statistic to training. Per-recording standardisation uses the whole unlabelled recording of the scored participant (transductive, label-free). No temporal-input model.
